change: v72: while a line is drawn with the smart pen its length is written next to the pointer, as ET 2017 writes it (in the unit of the pen's bar, inches to the sixteenth as ET writes them; the whole curve for a curve, each side of a rectangle at its middle, nothing with the T-square on); 综合测量 lists the totals of the measured lines in every size of a graded drawing with ET's 层间差 (against the neighbour toward the base) or 基础号型层间差 (against the base), as ET's table 要素检查; the measuring interface gives perSize. v71: ET's size table (the row 尺寸表与号型). ET's five size series (号型名称, A to E) are read, shown in the grading panel, renamed, switched (a click on a column's header, as in ET; the sizes take the names and positions of that series while the size table, kept by position, stays) and written back; a series without a name at the base position is refused, as ET refuses it. The size table has the column 纸样尺寸 (the last position of a row, where ET keeps it; 0 for a new row, as in ET's files). Names of the size table can be typed into the drafting tools and the smart pen as into ET's tool boxes ("袖长/10"): a name is its 纸样尺寸 in centimetres, a plain number is in the box's unit, and the formula is worked out once (ET keeps no drawn line tied to the table; a change of the table moves the graded sizes only). The rule table (ET's 放码规则表): named rules in groups kept on this computer, copied into a point or taken from one, ET's file MyRuleRecord.rtb read and written. A file without rules keeps its sizes and size table. One command more (grade.sizeSeries) and grade.setMeasure takes pattern.
validation: Node tests (74 scripts and 7 other suites), 37 real-browser suites with 1939 checks. v72: ET 2017 drew a line and a curve with its smart tool and wrote 5'1/8 and 7'1/4 next to the pointer; the page works the same out from what ET drew; ET's 长度测量 showed the totals of an edge and of two edges in S, M, L, XL and their 层间差, which the page gives too, and every line in every size is as long as in ET's own expansion (within 0.0001 mm). v71: in ET 2017 the series were switched in its 号型名称设定 and expanded, its parallel and notch tools were given size names, and its size table was changed after a line was drawn; the page gives the same sizes, header, lines and notches (within 0.0001 mm); files the page wrote were opened and expanded by ET; ET read a rule table the page wrote. Every earlier comparison with ET was made again with this code, and every earlier answer of the model examination was replayed with it.
